atomix:walk: Use case: stylized-concept. Production native sprite atlas for a high-quality 2D Ben 10 fighting game. Wide 2:1 canvas, ideally 3200x1600 pixels. Exactly EIGHT complete fully separated whole-body illustrations in a precise FOUR-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Crisp detailed faithful Ben 10 cartoon artwork, clean confident outlines, polished cel shading and solid readable anatomy. The SAME alien, same proportions, costume, badge and colors in all eight cells. All facing RIGHT in three-quarter side battle view. Genuine TRANSPARENT background. Each figure entirely inside its own cell with at least 30px clear transparent space around its head, feet, wings, tail and hands; no cropping at any canvas edge; no overlapping neighbors. No floor, shadows, text, labels, panel borders, or unrelated objects. Complete connected bodies, no segmented puppets. Character identity: Atomix from Ben 10 Omniverse: towering humanoid nuclear robot alien with white and light-grey armor, black segmented joints and waist, vivid glowing green reactor windows in chest and wrists, blocky green visor face, big round shoulder pauldrons and gauntlets, large green Omnitrix chest. Crisp white armor and luminous green energy.. Eight successive natural walking/running poses for this specific alien anatomy, alternating planted left and right feet in a continuous cycle, visible changing limb positions, no vibration. Keep full feet, tail and all arms.
